notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.settings_desc: Reminders for water, training, meals and your own, sent to this device.
notifications.desc: Reminders reach the installed app even when it is closed. Each one can be turned off, and the quiet hours apply to all of them.
notifications.flash.invalid: Check the times and the days: nothing was saved.
notifications.error.send: The notification could not be sent
notifications.state.ok_hint: The reminders below arrive here, also when the app is closed.
notifications.state.todo: Not on for this device yet
notifications.state.todo_hint: The browser will ask for permission.
notifications.state.ios_hint: On iPhone: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, and open the app from there.
notifications.state.blocked_hint: Allow notifications for this site in the browser's settings, then come back.
notifications.state.unsupported_hint: Notifications need HTTPS and a browser that supports push. Ask whoever runs this instance.
notifications.state.demo_hint: There is nobody to send them to. The settings below can be tried.
notifications.js.failed: Could not turn notifications on. Try again in a moment.
notifications.js.sent: Sent. Look at the notification on this device.
notifications.js.none: No device received it. Turn notifications on for this device first.
